summary: Public School Arc TV (AniList 166715, 11 eps, our 47-57) adapts chs 67-85 essentially in order at ~2 chapters per episode, with only two small scene relocations (ch68 office scene as ep47's cold open; a ch70 conversation shifted into ep49) and a standalone ch85 epilogue finale that ends on ch86's German werewolf-forest prologue as a teaser. Emerald Witch Arc TV (179054, 13 eps, our 58-70) adapts chs 86-107 in strict order with many mid-chapter episode breaks (fandom records page splits for every one), and the finale runs on through ch108 in full (Sieglinde's audience with the Queen, Sebastian sinking the SuLIN samples, Undertaker's night visit), so the old MU pin of 108 belongs at ep70 and the manga resumes at ch109 (vol 23, Blue Cult Arc). Flag #853 verified: PSA 67-85, EWA 86-107(+108). Book of Murder (20670) adapts chs 38-50 and Book of the Atlantic (21425) chs 51-65 (ch66's Easter egg hunt is unadapted); every source places them after Book of Circus and before Public School Arc, in that order. Fandom/Wikipedia overall numbering (47-57, 58-70) equals our cumulative numbering, so no episode-number conversion was needed for the wiki sources; 23 of 24 anchors are high confidence, ep67 is medium only because sources disagree on whether its C-part touches ch103.

structure.notes: Numbering: kuroshitsuji.fandom.com and Wikipedia both number these seasons cumulatively as 47-57 and 58-70 (Book of Circus = 37-46), i.e. exactly our cumulative numbering with the Book of Murder OVAs and the Atlantic film NOT counted; only per-season sources (Sportskeeda, under-taker.com, ANN, MAL) needed conversion (S4 epN = our 46+N, S5 epN = our 57+N). Season entries verified on AniList: 166715 Kuroshitsuji: Kishuku Gakkou-hen, TV, 11 eps, 2024-04-13..06-22 (our 47-57); 179054 Kuroshitsuji: Midori no Majo-hen, TV, 13 eps, 2025-04-05..06-28 (our 58-70); 20670 Book of Murder, OVA, 2 eps (2014-10-25 / 2014-11-15); 21425 Book of the Atlantic, MOVIE, 1 (2017-01-21). All 24 new episodes are canon (fandom Episodes table marks every one 'Y'; ScreenRant/MAL guide: Public School and Emerald Witch fully canon) - no filler, no type corrections. Flag #853 verified: Public School Arc = chs 67-85 (fandom arc page vols 14-18; CBR; wheredoestheanimeleaveoff 'continue at 86'), with ep57 also teasing ch86's prologue; Emerald Witch Arc = chs 86-107 (fandom arc page vols 18-22; CBR), with the finale ep70 also adapting ch108 in full - so the old MU pin 108 belongs at ep70 (Emerald Witch end) and the series' continue point is ch109 (vol 23, Blue Cult Arc), max_adapted_chapter 108. Watch order (fandom previous/next chain, ScreenRant, MAL 'Black Butler Anime Guide' stack, wheredoestheanimeleaveoff all agree): Book of Circus (37-46) -> Book of Murder (OVA x2) -> Book of the Atlantic (film) -> Public School Arc (47-57) -> Emerald Witch Arc (58-70). Unadapted manga in the gaps: ch37 'Brand New' (Nina Hopkins intro; between Circus and Murder - existing ep46 continue->37 stands), ch66 'Frenzied' (Easter egg hunt; after the film, before Public School - fandom ch66 'episodes: N/A', ScreenRant lists it as optional reading after Atlantic, under-taker calls it 未アニメ化), bonus ch107.5 (vol 22 extra).
